text_en: In the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 十一年十二月一日，上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, raise a lamentation over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him: You consider yourself a lion among the nations, but you are like a dragon in the seas; you thrash about in your streams, trouble the water with your feet, and foul your streams.
text_cn: “人子，你要唱哀歌追悼埃及王法郎，向他说：你曾自比作列国的雄狮，其实你却似海中的鳄鱼，冲入你的河中，用爪搅混了水，弄污了河流。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : In an assembly of many peoples I will throw my net over you; and I will haul you up in my dragnet.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：我要藉列国的联军向你张开我的罗网，用我的网把你拖上来。

text_en: I will throw you on the ground, on the open field I will fling you, and will cause all the birds of the air to settle on you, and I will let the wild animals of the whole earth gorge themselves with you.
text_cn: 我要把你丢在地上，抛在田野间，使天上的各种飞鸟落在你身上，使地上的各种野兽吃你吃个饱。

text_en: I will strew your flesh on the mountains, and fill the valleys with your carcass.
text_cn: 我要把你的肉丢在山上，用你尸首填满山谷，

text_en: I will drench the land with your flowing blood up to the mountains, and the watercourses will be filled with you.
text_cn: 用你的流汁灌溉大地，以你的血灌溉至山边，以你的腐尸填满沟壑。

text_en: When I blot you out, I will cover the heavens, and make their stars dark; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give its light.
text_cn: 当你被消灭时，我要遮蔽天空，使星辰也昏暗；以云彩遮住太阳，使月亮不放光明。

text_en: All the shining lights of the heavens I will darken above you, and put darkness on your land, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 我要使天上一切照在你身上的光体变为黑暗，使黑暗笼罩你的国土 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples, as I carry you captive among the nations, into countries you have not known.
text_cn: 当我在列国把你灭亡的消息，传到你不认识的国家时，我要使许多民族心神忧伤。

text_en: I will make many peoples appalled at you; their kings shall shudder because of you. When I brandish my sword before them, they shall tremble every moment for their lives, each one of them, on the day of your downfall.
text_cn: 当我在他们面前挥动我的刀剑时，我要使许多民族，为了你而惊骇，使她们的君王惊惶失措；在你倾覆之日，他们每人都为自己的性命而战栗。

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : The sword of the king of Babylon shall come against you.
text_cn: 因为吾主上主这样说：巴比伦王的刀剑必临于你。

text_en: I will cause your hordes to fall by the swords of mighty ones, all of them most terrible among the nations. They shall bring to ruin the pride of Egypt, and all its hordes shall perish.
text_cn: 我必使你的民众丧身在众英雄，即列国中最凶残之人的刀下；他们必要破坏埃及的光华，消灭她的民众。

text_en: I will destroy all its livestock from beside abundant waters; and no human foot shall trouble them any more, nor shall the hoofs of cattle trouble them.
text_cn: 我要从大水之旁，把她所有的牲畜灭绝，人脚不再搅混此水，兽蹄也不再使水混浊；

text_en: Then I will make their waters clear, and cause their streams to run like oil, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 那时，我要澄清他们的水，使他们的河徐徐流下如油一般 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: When I make the land of Egypt desolate and when the land is stripped of all that fills it, when I strike down all who live in it, then they shall know that I am the Lord .
text_cn: 当我使埃及地荒芜，使其他所有的一切荒废，打击其中所有居民时，他们必要承认我是上主。

text_en: This is a lamentation; it shall be chanted. The women of the nations shall chant it. Over Egypt and all its hordes they shall chant it, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 这是列国女子所要唱的哀歌，她们咏唱此歌凭吊埃及及其人民 —— 吾主上主的断语。”

text_en: In the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 十二年一月十五日，上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, wail over the hordes of Egypt, and send them down, with Egypt and the daughters of majestic nations, to the world below, with those who go down to the Pit.
text_cn: “人子，你要哀悼埃及的民众，因为我要将她和各强国的女儿推入阴间，同已下到阴府的人在一起。

text_en: “Whom do you surpass in beauty? Go down! Be laid to rest with the uncircumcised! ”
text_cn: 你比谁更华美呢？你下去吧！同未受割损的人卧在一起吧！

text_en: They shall fall among those who are killed by the sword. Egypt has been handed over to the sword; carry away both it and its hordes.
text_cn: 他们必倒在丧身刀下的人中，刀已交出，必使她和她的群众一起丧亡。

text_en: The mighty chiefs shall speak of them, with their helpers, out of the midst of Sheol: “They have come down, they lie still, the uncircumcised, killed by the sword. ”
text_cn: 最英勇的战士和她的同盟，必从阴府中论及她说：他们也下来了，同未受割损的人，同那些丧身刀下的人，卧在一起。

text_en: Assyria is there, and all its company, their graves all around it, all of them killed, fallen by the sword.
text_cn: 在那里有亚述，她的民众围绕着她的坟墓：他们都是被杀而丧身刀下的。

text_en: Their graves are set in the uttermost parts of the Pit. Its company is all around its grave, all of them killed, fallen by the sword, who spread terror in the land of the living.
text_cn: 他们的坟墓位于极深的坑中，她的民众围绕着她的坟墓：他们都是被杀而丧身刀下的，他们曾在活人地上，散布过恐怖。

text_en: Elam is there, and all its hordes around its grave; all of them killed, fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised into the world below, who spread terror in the land of the living. They bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.
text_cn: 在那里有厄蓝，她的民众都围绕着她的坟墓：他们都是被杀而丧身刀下的，未受割损而降入阴间的；他们曾在活人地上，散布过恐怖，所以他们与已下到深渊的人一同蒙受羞辱。

text_en: They have made Elam a bed among the slain with all its hordes, their graves all around it, all of them uncircumcised, killed by the sword; for terror of them was spread in the land of the living, and they bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit; they are placed among the slain.
text_cn: 在丧亡者中为她安置了床榻，她的民众围绕着她的坟墓：他们全是未受割损，丧身刀下的，因为他们曾在活人地上，散布过恐怖，所以被安置在被杀的人中，与已下到深渊的人一同蒙受羞辱。

text_en: Meshech and Tubal are there, and all their multitude, their graves all around them, all of them uncircumcised, killed by the sword; for they spread terror in the land of the living.
text_cn: 在那里有默舍客和突巴耳，她们的民众都围绕着她们的坟墓：他们全是未受割损，丧身刀下的；他们曾在活人地上，散布过恐怖。

text_en: And they do not lie with the fallen warriors of long ago who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war, whose swords were laid under their heads, and whose shields are upon their bones; for the terror of the warriors was in the land of the living.
text_cn: 他们不得与古代已死的英雄卧在一起，这些人带着武器降入阴府，人们把他们的刀剑放在他们头下，盾牌放在他们的骨骸上，因为他们曾在活人地上，散布过恐怖。

text_en: So you shall be broken and lie among the uncircumcised, with those who are killed by the sword.
text_cn: 至于你，你要卧在未受割损的人中，同丧身刀下的人在一起。

text_en: Edom is there, its kings and all its princes, who for all their might are laid with those who are killed by the sword; they lie with the uncircumcised, with those who go down to the Pit.
text_cn: 在那里有厄东和她的君王，以及她所有的首长，他们虽然英勇，却同丧身刀下的人被安置在一起，同未受割损而下到深渊的人卧在一起。

text_en: The princes of the north are there, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down in shame with the slain, for all the terror that they caused by their might; they lie uncircumcised with those who are killed by the sword, and bear their shame with those who go down to the Pit.
text_cn: 在那里有北方的一切首领和所有的漆冬人，他们虽然英勇，令人惊骇，也同被杀者一起下去了；他们同未受割损的人和丧身刀下的人卧在一起，与已下到深渊的人一同蒙受羞辱。

text_en: When Pharaoh sees them, he will be consoled for all his hordes—Pharaoh and all his army, killed by the sword, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 法郎看见那些人，便为自己所有的人民，感到安慰，因为法郎和他的军队也都是丧身刀下的 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: For he spread terror in the land of the living; therefore he shall be laid to rest among the uncircumcised, with those who are slain by the sword—Pharaoh and all his multitude, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 因为他曾在活人地上，散布过恐怖，所以法郎和他所有的人民，也都要卧在未受割损的人中，与丧身刀下的人在一起 —— 吾主上主的断语。”
